What changed:
- Added `_validate_errors`: rejects any non-finite error and any duplicate `(box, run, candidate)` key. All four public functions (`mae_of`, `fit`, `leave_one_box_out`, `learning_curve`) call it first, so unused runs/candidates and single-box inputs still raise.
- `mae_of` and `fit` treat runs as a set via `sorted(set(runs))`, so a run given twice counts once and order does not affect the result.
- `fit` raises `ValueError` when training runs are non-empty but no candidate covers all of them, instead of falling back to the default. Empty training still returns the default.

Held-out scoring already raised on missing errors through `mae_of`/`_abs_error`, so no change was needed there beyond the shared validation.
